title: Defining CSS Keyframe Animations
ques: Explain the role of the **`@keyframes`** at-rule. Write an animation named `pulse-glow` that scales an element and animates its box-shadow.
explanation: `@keyframes` controls the intermediate steps in a CSS animation sequence using percentage milestones from `0%` (`from`) to `100%` (`to`).

title: Mastering Easing Functions
ques: Compare CSS animation timing functions: **`linear`**, **`ease-in`**, **`ease-out`**, **`ease-in-out`**, and custom **`cubic-bezier()`**. Write an example demonstrating a springy cubic-bezier button hover.
explanation: Timing functions control animation velocity. Built-in keywords (`ease`, `ease-out`) use standard Bezier curves, while custom `cubic-bezier()` curves can produce realistic physical elasticity.

title: Staggering Effects with Animation Delays
ques: Demonstrate the use of **`animation-delay`** to create a staggered card entrance animation where three cards fade in sequentially.
explanation: `animation-delay` pauses the start of an animation. Pairing delays with `animation-fill-mode: forwards` creates coordinated, staggered entrance choreography.
